sm: Joe Rogan explains that he invited a paleontologist because he was frustrated by people who claim dinosaurs are not real. The guest, who has dug up many dinosaurs himself, says science is not a belief system and that predictions can be tested: depending on where you live, he can predict whether you will find fossils, since non-avian dinosaur fossils are only found in sedimentary rocks between about 237 and 66 million years old. They link the skepticism to creationism. On museum mounts, he says large skeletons are often replicas because mounting real bones damages them and blocks study, so originals are kept in collections. Missing pieces are estimated by comparing close relatives, as with the Dreadnoughtus skull and neck.
